notes:
Prospect: Lakeview Context Labs — mid-market B2B SaaS (retail catalog search & recommendations). Evaluating Hosted API first for rapid POC, then Dedicated for predictable throughput + VPC. Key asks: embeddings pipeline for 2M SKUs (nightly batch), real-time semantic search for product discovery (p99 latency target ~120ms), compatibility with Pinecone/Redis/Weaviate for vector storage, SDKs for Python + Go, token-level cost breakdowns during POC.

Summary of customer voice:
- "We need to re-index ~2M SKUs overnight and support spikes during marketing events — can't exceed 6h window for batch job."
- "Latency matters for homepage search — 80ms median, 120ms p95 acceptable."
- Cost: sensitive, prefers hosted for dev then dedicated reserved for production if price-per-vector acceptable.

POC notes:
- 2026-02-18: POC kickoff (hosted_api) — quick baseline embedding tests.
- 2026-02-25: Perf workshop w/ SE; simulated retrieval load (200 QPS) on hosted; median 95ms, p95 spikes observed.
- 2026-03-01: Security questionnaire submitted; asked for SOC2 excerpts, KMS + encryption in transit/at-rest details.
- 2026-03-03: Pinecone integration test done; connector functioned but added 15-25ms overhead in eu-west-1.
- 2026-03-05: Decided to run Dedicated test in eu-west-1 to validate autoscaling and VPC peering; requested reserved capacity quote.

Technical requirements:
- Embedding dim target ~1536; open or small commercial embedder preferred.
- Nightly batch: 2M records -> target 6 hours -> ~92k embeds/hr; parallel workers expected.
- Real-time retrieval: 100-200 peak QPS; 99th latency target <200ms E2E.
- Vector DB must support bulk upsert, namespace isolation, TTL.
- Observability: token/vector cost breakdown, per-route latency, tracing hooks.

Pricing discussions:
- Interested in committed reserved capacity for Dedicated; wants ARR estimate in 50k-150k range to justify commit.
- Asks for clear volume tiers and committed discount levels; transparent test billing during POC.

Risks / Concerns:
- EU data residency for top retailer customers.
- SOC2 + KMS integration required before procurement.
- Comparing Redwood dedicated pricing vs Pinecone + self-host alternatives.

Artifacts: proposal and SOC2 extract in Drive (links above), Fireflies ff_20260225_01, Jira RLW-1123 for infra questions.

Sales play: run SE-led dedicated test, provide detailed cost model and reserved-capacity pricing by 2026-03-15.
